ledger_offload_funds_subchannel (ArmadaLean/Nitro/Liveness.lean) is FALSE as
currently stated (pebble aln-147's worker found this while attempting to
remove its sorry; left sorry in place per Lean proof doctrine, since the
statement cannot be proved and must not be weakened by a worker).

Counterexample (machine-checked, compiles with `lake env lean
docs/counterexamples/ledger_offload_funds_subchannel.lean`, exit 0):
docs/counterexamples/ledger_offload_funds_subchannel.lean

Argument: the theorem's hypotheses never require w.chi (the funded
sub-channel) to be a ledger channel. Adjudicator.transfer pays a destination
only when Address.fundable, which is true for a channel destination only
when its kind = .ledger (a virtual channel "holds no assets of its own and
is never credited this way", Address.lean:110-116).
Reachable.balances_virtual_zero then forces a virtual-kind channel's
on-chain balance to 0 at every reachable Adjudicator. So if w.chi.kind =
.virtual and w.c > 0, FundedFor apps (Ts.T w.A) w.chi w.c (v w.A) can never
be won by any honest strategy: no finite UnbeatableIn derivation exists
(not_unbeatable_of_virtual in the counterexample file, by induction on the
putative derivation).

The hypothesis w.Holds apps Ts v places no constraint on w.chi.kind at all:
it only requires w.L to be a ledger channel, finalizable (not yet landed)
with the three-way outcome [dA, dB, chi]. Finalizable/ConclusionProof check
only that the outcome is signed by every participant, never that its
destinations are later payable. So the hypothesis is exactly as satisfiable
for a virtual chi as for a ledger one: the counterexample file adapts
NonVacuity.lean's own funded witness for this theorem (wLSF/nLWF, "D10
ruling") verbatim, changing only chi's kind from .ledger to .virtual, and it
still satisfies every hypothesis, with w.c = 5 > 0.

docs/nitro-repair-2026-10-27.md (defect 23) already flagged this exact gap:
"Needs the G16 hypotheses of ledger_partial_withdrawal for chi" --
ledger_partial_withdrawal requires its receiving ledger L' to carry
IsLedgerChannel apps L' (Liveness.lean:7547); ledger_offload_funds_subchannel
never gained the analogous hypothesis for chi. Its re-audit row has been
updated from "unknown" to "false" with this counterexample cited.

Fix (requires an operator/coordinator statement-change decision, out of
scope for a sorry-removal worker): add a hypothesis
`(hchi : IsLedgerChannel apps w.chi)` to ledger_offload_funds_subchannel,
then re-attempt the proof (the witness machinery in
docs/counterexamples/ledger_offload_funds_subchannel.lean -- reachability
threading over Threat.RoundSeq, non-vacuity construction reuse -- is
directly reusable for the positive proof once chi is forced ledger-kind:
Address.fundable w.chi.address = true follows from hchi, letting
Adjudicator.transfer land L -> chi the same way ledger_partial_withdrawal's
conclude_transfer_pays lands L -> L').

Blocks aln-147 (cannot remove sorry from a false theorem without either
weakening/changing its statement, which a worker must not do unilaterally,
or using an unsound proof).
